rejected_rule.statement: A decision by a Court of requests that a minor is not the legitimate son of an individual does not bar the same individual from reopening the issue of legitimacy in testamentary proceedings where they are not parties to both cases.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "The parties in D- C, Jaffna, 1,334, are personally the same as the real contestants in C. E., Point Pedro, 8,511. The legitimacy of Velupillai is in issue in both cases. ... I think that where, as in C. E., Point Pedro, 8,511, the fact of legitimacy is asserted or denied as a ground for the acceptance or rejection of a claim, it may fairly be said that a 'right to relief' has been set up or put in issue between the parties."
